scope: One scripted development-case capacity diagnostic, not adaptive overall or held-out selection
method: Native full-history cache; no retrieval, learned reader, commit forcing or training
runtime: H200 Torch2.6 SDPA; text encoder offloaded before rendering
hypothesis: If retention is the bottleneck, full native history should recover initial street landmarks better than cache18. More history need not improve quality.
validation: Match source/checkpoint/image/caption/actions/seed/sampler/backend/hardware. Require raw pixels to match stock before cache18 first evicts history; retain entire video, all failures, actual return evidence and memory peak. No predeclared score win.
